t: By default, the $(2)Sphere Mode$() sets the Projector to generate a force field in the shape of a sphere that is exactly 1 block thick. Each $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)Scale Module$() increases the size of the force field by 1 block.
默认情况下，$(2)球体模式$()会将投射器设置为生成厚度恰好为1个方块的球形力场。每个$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)扩展模块$()均可使力场整体扩大1个方块。
Adding $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)Scale Module$()s to item slots marked with a directional arrow further increases the radius of the force field by 1 block per module.
向带有方向箭头标记的物品槽中添加$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)扩展模块$()，可进一步将力场半径扩大1个方块/模块。
A scaled $(2)Sphere Mode$() field being projected.
一个已缩放的$(2)球体模式$()力场正在被投射。
